name: NCAA D-III Great Lakes Regional Cross Country Championships
where: East Lansing, MI · host Olivet · Forest Akers East
headline: NCAA D-III Great Lakes Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 15 Hope edged No. 16 Calvin 84 to 85 for the women’s title, with No. 23 John Carroll third (120), as Rose-Hulman’s Jocelyn Onstot won in 21:52.9. No. 20 Hope swept the team titles by winning the men’s race with 82 points over No. 30 Calvin (111) and No. 28 Case Western Reserve (123). John Carroll’s Sam Su won the men’s race in 24:57.0, 10.2 seconds ahead of Case Western’s Jacob Slater.
